annotations.title: US Treasury interest rates: average rates on bills, notes, bonds and all federal debt, monthly

description: Average interest rates on US Treasury securities by month from the Treasury's Fiscal Data: bills, notes, bonds, TIPS, floating rate notes and the non-marketable series, with totals for marketable, non-marketable and all interest-bearing debt, for the latest month and up to 24 months. US federal data, public domain, from a dated snapshot. Use for the US government's borrowing cost, a rate trend or macro context; not a live yield curve. Example: months=12. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

months.description: Months of history for the totals, 1-24 (default 12)

security.description: Optional filter on the security name: bills, notes, bonds, TIPS, floating, marketable…
